overview: This paper proposes Parallel-R1, a reinforcement learning framework with a progressive curriculum to instill adaptive parallel thinking in LLMs for mathematical reasoning, utilizing a cold-start SFT stage on prompted data and subsequent RL with alternating reward strategies to evolve the model's reasoning from exploration to verification.

modules.name: Parallel-GSM8K Data Generation Pipeline
modules.description: Generates cold-start parallel thinking trajectories by prompting a base LLM with detailed instructions on GSM8K questions, and extracts the non-thinking parts to serve as gold annotations.

modules.name: Parallel Format Validator
modules.description: Implements a stack-based algorithm to validate the structural integrity and correct nesting of generated parallel thinking data, ensuring proper usage of Parallel, Path, and Summary tags.

modules.name: Parallel-Aware Dataset and DataLoader
modules.description: Handles the loading, tokenization, and batching of the Parallel-GSM8K and DAPO datasets, specifically managing the custom control tags and preparing inputs for SFT and RL training phases.

modules.name: Autoregressive Parallel-R1 Architecture (Parallel-Seen)
modules.description: Wraps the base autoregressive LLM to support the generation and processing of parallel thinking tags sequentially without modifying the underlying attention mechanism.

modules.name: Multiverse Parallel-R1 Architecture (Parallel-Unseen)
modules.description: Modifies the LLM's attention mechanism by applying custom 4D attention masks and shared position encodings to enforce strict isolation between parallel reasoning paths during both forward computation and backward gradient calculation.

modules.name: GRPO Rollout Engine
modules.description: Manages the multi-turn interactive rollout process for reinforcement learning, alternating between standard autoregressive generation, spawning multiple parallel reasoning branches, and generating summaries.

modules.name: Reward Design and Computation
modules.description: Implements various reward strategies including the strict binary Accuracy/Parallel combined reward, the Alternating Accuracy/Parallel reward with configurable windows and frequencies, and the pure Accuracy reward.

modules.name: Curriculum Training Orchestrator
modules.description: Controls the progressive training pipeline, managing the transitions between the SFT cold-start stage, RL on easy math, and RL on general math, including dynamic switching of datasets and reward functions.

modules.name: GRPO Optimization and Training Loop
modules.description: Implements the Group Relative Policy Optimization algorithm, calculating group-relative advantages, applying clipped surrogate objectives, and managing KL penalties to update the policy model.

modules.name: Parallel Inference and Decoding Engine
modules.description: Handles the dynamic inference workflow by detecting Parallel tokens, spawning concurrent generation threads for distinct paths, aggregating their outputs into a Summary, and resuming the main reasoning thread.

modules.name: Benchmark Evaluation Suite
modules.description: Evaluates model performance on AIME, AMC, and MATH mathematical reasoning benchmarks, computing Mean@16, Pass@16, and Mean@1 metrics while filtering LaTeX artifacts.

modules.name: Path Diversity Analysis Module
modules.description: Computes token-level diversity using pairwise BLEU scores and semantic diversity using pairwise cosine similarity on sentence embeddings between different paths within the same parallel thinking block.

modules.name: Training Dynamics and Behavior Analysis
modules.description: Tracks and analyzes the positional dynamics of Parallel blocks during RL training, calculating the relative token position to observe the strategic shift from early-stage exploration to late-stage verification.

modules.name: Mid-Training Scaffold Executor
modules.description: Implements the two-stage RL experiment where an initial forced-exploration phase using alternating rewards is followed by an exploitation phase using accuracy-only rewards to analyze the performance ceiling unlocked by parallel thinking.
